purpose: Canonical corrected status for Martingale rounds 1-14. Final Round 14 results with XS selector breakthrough.

wfo_results.finding: Parameter selection is 100% stable but validation performance is highly volatile. F2(2024) and F3(2025) positive, F1(H2-2023) and F4(2026-YTD) negative. F3 achieves DD=8.39% (below conservative gate). Strategy is period-dependent.

conservative.verdict: ann and pos met, DD close but exceeds 10% gate

balanced.verdict: ann met at 1000U, DD almost met at 3000U (20.29 vs 20.0)

round14_key_findings: XS selector is the breakthrough: ann improved from ~24% to 35-38%
XS-REV on ICP+TRX achieves 5/5 positive segments (first ever)
P4 dual-state SO scale 0.75 reduces DD from 14.44% to 13.83% (best achievable)
SO scale <0.5 INCREASES DD: positions stay open longer, accumulate more loss
DD 10% conservative gate is a HARD FLOOR for martingale DCA - not reachable
XS-MOM on R4-combo at 3000U: ann=50.05% hits conservative gate
XS-REV on R4-combo at 1000U: ann=101.92% close to aggressive gate
Exit mechanisms (minigrid, depth TP) consistently reduce ann by 60-80%
Depth TP achieves DD<10% and 5/5 positive but ann<10%
Budget cliff is critical: smaller budget → higher ann, higher DD
2025 weakness resolved on ICP+TRX (5/5 positive) but persists on R4-combo (4/5)
